_note: I037d: mountain_of_souls enemies (bank 1F): ms_multi_area_enemies, ms_enemy_0FCFD6 (Ice Maker), ms_enemy_0FD058 (Ice Crystal). Light depth. Types are matched to the bestiary by HP and EXP (inferred in MetaMountainOfSouls); lair assignments come from LairRecords; open points are OQ-I037-n and the existing OQ-I033-1 / OQ-I033-3.

blockNote: Nine monsters of the Mountain of Souls and their projectiles (file offsets 1034031-1036245 and 1036571-1036916, SNES $1F:C72F-$CFD5 and $1F:D11B-$D274): Green Lizard, Undead Caribou, Yeti, Fire Bat, the snowball, Purple Wizard, Red Wizard, Cave Bat and Green Blob. The Ice Maker and the Ice Crystal lie between the two ranges in their own files.
=== ROSTER (meta type of MetaMountainOfSouls: attack / defence / HP / EXP; lair records that spawn it) ===
- $2D ms_enemy_green_lizard_0FC72F: 9 / 6 / 8 / 65; lairs $CA, $D3, $D4, $EB, $EC. A burrowing patroller that emerges when the hero is near.
- $2E ms_enemy_undead_caribou_0FC845: 11 / 6 / 25 / 70; lair $EA. Wakes up, walks to the hero and throws its head.
- $2F ms_enemy_yeti_0FC8FE: 10 / 3 / 20 / 80; lairs $C9, $E9. Chases the hero (clubs).
- $30 ms_enemy_fire_bat_0FC9BC: 9 / 5 / 14 / 85; lairs $CB, $CC. Flaps and shoots fireballs.

- $31 ms_enemy_snowball_0FCA35: 10 / 4 / 40 / 2000; no lair, placed in A0BS02 (5 times) and A0CS01 (2 times). Rolls toward the hero; no bestiary row (OQ-I033-3), the name is the walkthrough's ('dodge the snowballs').
- $32 ms_enemy_purple_wizard_0FCBDF: 14 / 5 / 17 / 85; lairs $F6, $F7, $F8, $FC. Teleports 4 tiles from the hero and fires one bolt.
- $33 ms_enemy_red_wizard_0FCDBA: 14 / 4 / 20 / 100; lairs $D6, $D7, $FF. The same at 2 tiles with three fireballs.
- $36 ms_enemy_cave_bat_0FD11B: 13 / 6 / 14 / 75; lairs $E6, $E8, $F2, $FA, $FE. Flies after the hero.
- $37 ms_enemy_green_blob_0FD1E5: 12 / 6 / 12 / 80; lairs $D9, $DD, $E1, $EE, $EF, $F0. Bounces, half of its hops toward the hero.

HP is a hex byte (the bestiary agrees: 8, 25, 20, 14, 17, 20, 14, 12); EXP is BCD. The lair assignments are those of the lair records with home location $3D, $41 or $45 listed in the Soul of Mountain House notes.
=== CONVENTIONS OF THE SCRIPTS ===

- COP AD (#08) waits while the actor is off screen. COP 0C (slot 0, margin) jumps when the hero lies inside the actor's box widened by the margin (the 'near' test). COP 9A / 9B / 9C steer by the hero's position relative to the actor (9A on x, 9B on y: left or above / within / right or below; 9C picks the dominant axis). COP A5 jumps by the flip state set by the lair at spawn (none / flip X / flip Y / both), so the four monsters of one lair start in different directions.

- The motion itself is in the animations (COP 80 / 82, COP 81 / 83); the scripts only choose the animation and its flip. Projectiles are short-lived actors: $16 = $0200 makes the actor a hostile hitbox, $0300 also hides it from hits; draw priority with COP A3 / A4 / A2.
- Only the Green Lizard moves the actor itself (COP 9F / A0 add to X / Y).
=== OPEN ===

The lair monsters differ from the walkthrough in places: the lairs of $CB and $CC (North slope, Aurora's Ridge) spawn type $30 (Fire Bat stats, fireballs) where the walkthrough says Cave Bats; Nome's lair $D6 holds Red Wizards where the walkthrough says lizards (OQ-I037-2). The matching of types to monsters is inferred from HP and EXP (see MetaMountainOfSouls).

blockNote: The Ice Maker and its ice spikes (file offsets 1036246-1036375, SNES $1F:CFD6-$D057).
=== WHAT RUNS HERE ===

Type $34 (attack 14, defence 7, HP 24, EXP 70; placed in A0BS04 and A0BS05, four times each; no lair): waits for the screen (COP AD), plays animation $18, animation $19 eight times (the cast), spawns four spikes, plays animation $18 twelve times and repeats. Each spike is an actor that places itself on the tile 2 tiles ($20 pixels) above, below, left or right of the hero and grows there. The walkthrough: 'Ice Maker enemies ... will make icy spikes appear from the ground to hurt you; if you don't move fast, you will get hurt.' (the bestiary: 24 HP, 70 EXP, 'makes ice spikes').
=== OPEN ===
Which animation frames hurt the hero (the spike's hitbox is $16 = $0200 during animation $17) was not checked at runtime.

blockNote: The Ice Crystal and its shards (file offsets 1036376-1036570, SNES $1F:D058-$D11A).
=== WHAT RUNS HERE ===

Type $35 (attack 13, defence 0, HP 24, EXP word $4000; placed in A0CS02 four times and A0CS03 eight times; no lair): the crystal sets bit $0100 of $1A, waits for the screen and loops animation $1A while it watches the byte at +$25, the actor's current HP (ApplySwordDamage subtracts from $25). While it equals the meta HP ($18 = 24) nothing happens (after eight watches the idle animation $1B is played); as soon as it differs, i.e. the crystal was hit, it becomes hostile ($16 = $0200), plays the burst animation $1C, makes sound $64, spawns eight shards in the eight directions (four animations, flipped) and dies after animation $1D. The walkthrough warns: 'four Ice Crystals around a Purple Wizard lair ... it's best to deal with them through sword slashes ... as you'll risk triggering the explosions of all four'; the bestiary: 'explodes when hit', '? HP, 0 EXP' (the ROM HP is 24 and the EXP word $4000: OQ-I033-3).
=== OPEN ===
Bit $0100 of $1A (set at the start) and the EXP word $4000 are not explained (OQ-I033-3 for the latter).
